seasons.title: Temporada 1: Vovó Turbo & Ocultismo Alienígena
seasons.synopsis: Momo Ayase acredita em fantasmas e Okarun acredita em alienígenas. Quando ambos descobrem que os dois existem, despertam poderes paranormais insanos.

episodes.title: That's How Love Starts, Ya Know!
episodes.synopsis: Momo is a high school girl born to a family of spirit mediums, and Okarun is an occult fanatic. To settle an argument, Momo heads to an abandoned hospital famous for UFO sightings while Okarun heads to a tunnel famous as a spiritual hotspot.

episodes.title: That's a Space Alien, Ain't It?!
episodes.synopsis: Momo awakens psychic powers, while Okarun is cursed by Turbo Granny. They evacuate to Momo's house, but a giant alien appears before them.

episodes.title: It's a Granny vs. Granny Clash!
episodes.synopsis: Okarun's crisis is saved by Momo's grandmother Seiko. Okarun must now play tag with Turbo Granny to lift his curse.

episodes.title: Kicking Turbo Granny's Ass
episodes.synopsis: Momo and Okarun succeed in capturing Turbo Granny through their game of tag. However, a crab-shaped location-bound spirit approaches them.

episodes.title: Like, Where Are Your Balls?!
episodes.synopsis: Victorious against Turbo Granny, Momo and Okarun regain peace, but for some reason Okarun's "thingie" hasn't returned…

episodes.title: A Dangerous Woman Appears
episodes.synopsis: Their classmate Aira had the missing golden ball. Perhaps the effects of the ball, but Aira can now see "invisible things."

episodes.title: To a Kinder World
episodes.synopsis: Momo and Okarun manage to pull Acrobatic Silky away from Aira. However, Aira has lost her life...

episodes.title: I've Got This Funny Feeling
episodes.synopsis: The battle against Acrobatic Silky is over, a normal school life briefly returns to the three before Serpoians show up before them.

episodes.title: Merge! Serpo Dover Demon Nessie!
episodes.synopsis: Aira has awakened the powers of Acrobatic Silky within her. She joins the battle against aliens together with Momo and Okarun.

episodes.title: Have You Ever Seen a Cattle Mutilation?
episodes.synopsis: Momo, Okarun, and Aira make it through the alien assault by combining their powers. However, the alien that was supposedly defeated appears before them...

episodes.title: First Love
episodes.synopsis: Momo's childhood friend Jiji begins living in Momo's house. Jiji has been worrying about apparitions in the house he moved into and has come seeking help from Seiko.

episodes.title: Let's Go to the Cursed House
episodes.synopsis: Momo and Okarun head to Jiji's house to investigate the case of Jiji's family. There are several shadows watching them…

seasons.title: Temporada 2: Arco do Olho Maligno (Evil Eye)
seasons.synopsis: Na casa amaldiçoada de Jiji nas fontes termais, Momo e Okarun enfrentam a entidade ancestral conhecida como Olho Maligno.

seasons.title: Parte 1: A Guerra Sangrenta dos Mil Anos
seasons.synopsis: O Imperador Quincy Yhwach e o Wandenreich invadem a Soul Society, levando os Capitães do Gotei 13 ao limite absoluto.

episodes.title: THE BLOOD WARFARE
episodes.synopsis: The Soul Society’s Department of Research and Development is observing a sudden surge in the number of Hollows being destroyed in the World of the Living, raising concerns among staff.

episodes.title: Foundation Stones
episodes.synopsis: Arrancars Nel Tu and Pesche Guatiche have come to seek Ichigo’s help explaining that Hueco Mundo is under attack by an unknown enemy. Unable to ignore the situation, Ichigo and his friends decide to set out for Hueco Mundo.

episodes.title: March of the StarCross
episodes.synopsis: Ichigo and his friends arrive in Hueco Mundo to confront Quilge Opie and learn that their latest enemy are Quincies.

episodes.title: Kill The Shadow
episodes.synopsis: The Wandenreich mobilizes its elite force, the Stern Ritter, to annihilate the Soul Society. Creating massive flaming pillars of Reishi as a distraction, the Stern Ritter easily enter the Soul Society to bring carnage to the Soul Reapers.

episodes.title: Wrath as a Lightning
episodes.synopsis: Quilge Opie uses his power to imprison Ichigo inside the Garganta. As he tries to break free, Ichigo begins to hear, through his Soul Phone, the screams of the Soul Reapers falling to the enemy's onslaught.

episodes.title: The Fire
episodes.synopsis: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto confronts Yhwach for the first time in a thousand years. As Yhwach finally draws his sword against Genryusai, the Soul Reapers notice an abnormal change taking place across the Seireitei.

episodes.title: BORN IN THE DARK
episodes.synopsis: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto learns that the Yhwach he defeated was an impostor. The real Yhwach then reveals himself and easily kills Genryusai, sending a wave of shock and devastation across the Soul Reapers.

episodes.title: The Shooting Star Project (ZERO MIX)
episodes.synopsis: Rescue efforts are being made across the Seireitei to find and help those who've survived the Stern Ritter attack. Meanwhile, Ichigo meets with Mayuri Kurotsuchi about fixing his broken Tensa Zangetsu.

episodes.title: THE DROP
episodes.synopsis: Squad Zero brings Ichigo back to the Royal Palace to prepare for the coming battle. Meanwhile, Kyoraku is appointed as the new Head Captain to lead the Thirteen Court Guard Squads.

episodes.title: The Battle
episodes.synopsis: Kenpachi Zaraki removes his eye patch to fight Retsu Unohana, a.k.a. Yachiru Unohana, "The First Kenpachi." Meanwhile, Ichigo and Renji head to Hoohden to meet Oh-Etsu Nimaiya, the man who is said to have created the Zanpakuto.

episodes.title: Everything But the Rain
episodes.synopsis: Ichigo is kicked out of the Royal Palace by Oh-etsu Nimaiya for failing his test. When Ichigo next opens his eyes, he finds himself standing in front of his house in the World of the Living.

episodes.title: EVERYTHING BUT THE RAIN "June Truth"
episodes.synopsis: Squad 10 Captain Isshin Shiba of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads decides to not report his encounter with the Quincy named Masaki Kurosaki in the World of the Living to the Head Captain.

episodes.title: THE BLADE IS ME
episodes.synopsis: Ichigo decides to return to Hoohden with a renewed resolve to finish what he has started.

seasons.title: Parte 2: A Separação (The Separation)
seasons.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki forja suas novas Zanpakuto no Palácio Real enquanto Uryu Ishida se une ao exército de Yhwach.

episodes.title: THE LAST 9DAYS
episodes.synopsis: Ichigo prepares to leave the Royal Palace to return to the Seireitei but is stopped by Hyosube, who claims Ichigo cannot defeat Yhwach as he is now.

episodes.title: Peace from Shadows
episodes.synopsis: Yhwach sets his plan to end the world in nine days in motion by pulling the Seireitei into the Schatten Bereich for the Stern Ritter to invade.

episodes.title: The Fundamental Virulence
episodes.synopsis: Mayuri receives a call from Urahara, who had stayed behind in Hueco Mundo to search for a way to reclaim everyone’s stolen Bankai. Urahara claims that he was able to come up with a solution based on the data gained from his earlier battle with Quilge.

episodes.title: HEART of WOLF
episodes.synopsis: The tides of battle seemed to have turned after the captains reclaimed their stolen Bankai. However, the Stern Ritters release their Quincy Voll Stern Dich to drive the Soul Reapers deeper into a corner.

episodes.title: Rages at Ringside
episodes.synopsis: Kensei Muguruma joins the battle against Masculine, who has already defeated Shuhei Hisagi, Ikkaku Madarame, and Yumichika Ayasegawa. However, Kensei is taken aback by how weak his opponent is.

episodes.title: The White Haze
episodes.synopsis: A fearless Rukia swings her Sodenoshirayuki in battle as she takes on Äs Nödt.

episodes.title: I AM THE EDGE
episodes.synopsis: Isane and Yachiru are treating the wounded Kensei and Rojuro when they are attacked by Gwenael, a Quincy who not only possesses the ability to disappear physically but can also erase his existence from the memory of his opponents.

episodes.title: The Headless Star
episodes.synopsis: Kenpachi defeats Gremmy, but his moment of victory is cut short when he is suddenly struck by Candice’s thunderbolt attack. Meninas, Giselle, and Liltotto also join Candice to take down Kenpachi, who is considered to be a Special Threat.

episodes.title: Marching Out the ZOMBIES
episodes.synopsis: Ichigo and the Soul Reapers try to stop Yhwach upon learning that his real target lies within the Royal Palace. However, their efforts are thwarted by Uryu, who stands in Ichigo’s way in order to allow Yhwach safe passage to the Royal Palace.

episodes.title: Marching Out the ZOMBIES 2
episodes.synopsis: Ikkaku, Yumichika, and the Arrancars work together to fight off Giselle’s zombies. But the group is shocked when Giselle reveals her next pawn, who is none other than Captain Hitsugaya of Squad 10.

episodes.title: Too Early To Win, Too Late To Know
episodes.synopsis: Yhwach finally steps through the main entrance of the Royal Palace. Accompanied by Haschwalth and Uryu, the Quincy King is preparing to advance toward the Greater Palace when they are stopped by Senjumaru Shutara of Squad Zero.

episodes.title: THE MASTER
episodes.synopsis: Yhwach escapes from the cage surrounding Squad Zero's fake Royal Palace to confront Hyosube, who is protecting the real Royal Palace.

episodes.title: BLACK
episodes.synopsis: Yhwach performs Auswählen to bestow power to his fallen Royal Guards and activate their Voll Stern Dich forms. What follows is a fierce battle between the Royal Guards and Squad Zero.

seasons.title: Parte 3: O Conflito (The Conflict)
seasons.synopsis: A batalha pelo Trono do Rei das Almas coloca a Divisão Zero e os Shinigamis contra a Schutzstaffel de elite de Yhwach.

episodes.title: A
episodes.synopsis: The battle between Squad Zero and Yhwach's Royal Guards for the Soul King rages on.

episodes.title: KILL THE KING
episodes.synopsis: Ichigo and his friends hurry to the Reio Greater Palace to stop Yhwach.

episodes.title: The Dark Arm
episodes.synopsis: Ichigo tries to remove the impaled sword from the Soul King and save his life.

episodes.title: The Betrayer
episodes.synopsis: Ukitake takes the place of the slain Soul King by releasing the power of Mimihagi.

episodes.title: AGAINST THE JUDGEMENT
episodes.synopsis: Yhwach is overflowing with power from having absorbed the Soul King.

episodes.title: THE HOLY NEWBORN
episodes.synopsis: The Soul Reapers regroup to prepare their counterattack against the Quincies.

episodes.title: GATE OF THE SUN
episodes.synopsis: Yhwach builds his new castle, Wahr Welt.

episodes.title: BABY, HOLD YOUR HAND
episodes.synopsis: Kenpachi and Mayuri's group advance through Vier Ast.

episodes.title: DON'T CHASE A SHADOW
episodes.synopsis: The change in Mayuri's Spiritual Pressure is also felt elsewhere by Urahara and Kyoraku.

episodes.title: BABY, HOLD YOUR HAND 2 [Never Ending My Dream]
episodes.synopsis: Nemu ignores Mayuri's orders by intervening in his battle against Pernida.

episodes.title: SHADOWS GONE
episodes.synopsis: Lille undergoes further transformation to hunt down and pass judgment on Kyoraku.

episodes.title: friend
episodes.synopsis: Haschwalth finds himself confronted by Bazz-B.

episodes.title: The Visible Answer
episodes.synopsis: Kyoraku has paved the way for the Soul Reapers to reach the enemy's stronghold.

episodes.title: MY LAST WORDS
episodes.synopsis: Haschwalth suddenly attacks Uryu to pass judgment.

seasons.title: Parte 4: A Calamidade (The Calamity)
seasons.synopsis: O ato final no Wahrwelt decide o destino dos três mundos no confronto definitivo contra o Todo-Poderoso Yhwach.

seasons.title: Temporada 1: A Queda de Shiganshina & A Titã Fêmea
seasons.synopsis: Após a destruição da Muralha Maria pelo Titã Colossal, Eren Yeager, Mikasa e Armin alistam-se na Divisão de Reconhecimento.

episodes.title: To You Two Thousand Years Later
episodes.synopsis:
The Fall of Shiganshina, Part 1.
After one hundred years of peace, humanity is suddenly reminded of the terror of being at the Titans' mercy.

episodes.title: That Day
episodes.synopsis:
The Fall of Shiganshina, Part 2.
After the Titans break through the wall, the citizens of Shiganshina must run for their lives. However, those that do make it to safety find a harsh life waiting for them.

episodes.title: Shining Dimly in the Midst of Despair
episodes.synopsis: Eren begins his training with the Cadet Corps, but questions about his painful past overwhelm him. When he struggles with a maneuvering exercise, Berholt and Reiner offer kindly advice.

episodes.title: Night of the Disbanding
episodes.synopsis: Annie proves her skill in a sparring session, Jan dreams of serving alongside the King, and graduation day brings shocking revelations - along with a sudden outbreak of violence!

episodes.title: First Battle
episodes.synopsis: Eren faces off against the Colossal Titan after it appears out of nowhere and knocks a strategic hole in the Rose Wall gate. As Titans swarm the city, the newly graduated Cadets are called in to fight in brutal battle that won't be without casualties.

episodes.title: The World She Saw
episodes.synopsis: Armin tries to cope with the loss of his friends and allies after Titans massacre his squad. Elsewhere in the city, Mikasa manages to take out several of the monsters, which brings back tragic memories of her past and the first time she met Eren.

episodes.title: The Small Blade
episodes.synopsis: After the retreat bell sounds, many cadets find themselves without enough fuel to scale the wall back to safety. Mikasa begins to lose hope once she hears of the deaths in Armin's squad, but the appearance of a new type of Titan stokes her will to fight.

episodes.title: Hearing the Heartbeat
episodes.synopsis: Armin comes up with a risky plan that pits Titan against Titan as the abandoned Cadets attempt to take back their headquarters. Getting into the building might be possible, but getting out alive and refueled will mean facing more of the giants.

episodes.title: The Left Arm's Trace
episodes.synopsis: A miraculous return is met with anger and fear. Cannons are fixed on Eren as he struggles to remember what happened to him inside the belly of a monster and how he ended up humankind's enemy. One question is all that matters: is Eren human or Titan?

episodes.title: Answer
episodes.synopsis: Cadets respond to Eren's terrifying transformation with doubt and fear as he struggles to understand it himself. If Armin can't talk the commander into using Eren's newfound powers for the good of humankind, all hope of stopping the Titans might be lost.

episodes.title: Idol
episodes.synopsis: Plans are created to use Eren's Titan powers to seal the hole in the wall in an attempt to reclaim Trost. But with the government's bloodstained history and vocal dissenters in the military ranks, the biggest threat to humankind may not be the Titans.

episodes.title: Wound
episodes.synopsis: The plan to reclaim Trost falls apart when Eren's newfound powers turn him into a mindless giant. As Titans continue to swarm the city, it's up to Armin and Mikasa to make sure the cadets massacred during the mission haven't died in vain.

episodes.title: Primordial Desire
episodes.synopsis: Jean takes desperate measures to replace his broken maneuvering device. Meanwhile, Eren is able to plug the hole in the wall thanks to the help of his fellow cadets, but the cost of humanity's first victory against the Titans will be gigantic.

episodes.title: Can't Look Into His Eyes
episodes.synopsis: A special military tribunal will decide Eren's fate. The Military Police calls for his execution while the Scout Regiment argues that he is a powerful resource for humankind, and Mikasa is put on the spot when asked about the events of the Trost mission.

episodes.title: Special Operations Squad
episodes.synopsis: The Scout Regiment moves Eren to an old abandoned castle where he will continue his training. Hanzi visits and reveals that she's been putting two captured Titans through a series of tests and trials - experiments that she wants Eren's help with.

episodes.title: What To Do Now
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is a suspect in the investigation to find out who killed the two test-subject Titans. Meanwhile, the Cadets pick which corps they'll be joining, but after the harrowing events in the Trost attack, many are uncertain which branch to choose.

episodes.title: The Female Titan
episodes.synopsis: As the Scout Regiment begins its push toward Shiganshina, they encounter an intelligent Female Titan unlike any they've seen before. When Armin hypothesizes that it's really a human that's been turned into a Titan, he, Jean, and Reiner attempt to stop it.

episodes.title: The Forest of Giant Trees
episodes.synopsis: As the Female Titan continues to tear its way through the Scout Regiment, Levi makes a bold decision to split the ranks and send Eren and the supply wagons through a huge forest. Is his strategy genius, or does it spell certain death for the scouts?

episodes.title: Bite
episodes.synopsis: A memory of Eren testing out his Titan powers sheds new light on how his abilities work. As the Female Titan continues to slaughter members of the Scout Regiment, Eren is faced with a difficult decisions: does he trust his teammates or act out on his own?

episodes.title: Erwin Smith
episodes.synopsis: The Female Titan has been captured, and it's Erwin's goal to find out who the human is lurking inside it. Meanwhile, the Scouts realize that the reason Levi told no one about their true mission outside the wall is because there is a spy among them.

episodes.title: Crushing Blow
episodes.synopsis: A traitor has infiltrated the Scout Regiment, destroying their ranks from within. When cornered, she once again takes the form of the Female Titan - but this time, Eren's not going to let her get away without one insanely brutal fight.

episodes.title: The Defeated
episodes.synopsis: After watching Eren get swallowed by the Female Titan, Mikasa and Levi follow the brutal monster in the hopes that he's still alive inside her. As the Scout Regiment tries to recover from the devastating losses of the operation, emotions run high.

episodes.title: Smile
episodes.synopsis: After the failed scouting expedition, Eren and his superiors are summoned to the capital. Annie witnesses just how deep corruption runs in the Military Police, and agrees to join Armin in a plot to defy the government - but nothing is really as it seems.

episodes.title: Mercy
episodes.synopsis: When the identity of the Female Titan is finally revealed, she goes on a rampage within Wall Sina. Eren is hesitant to fight her, but Armin and Mikasa throw themselves into of the battle in a desperate attempt to stop the towering monster.

episodes.title: Wall
episodes.synopsis: Eren goes head-to-head with the Female Titan in a fight that demolishes the Stohess District inside Wall Sina. As the number of casualties skyrockets and Annie tries to escape over the wall, Erwin must deal with the consequences of his plan.

seasons.title: Temporada 2: O Rugido dos Titãs & A Coordenada
seasons.synopsis: A aparição do Titã Bestial e a revelação de traidores dentro das muralhas mudam para sempre a compreensão da humanidade.

episodes.title: Beast Titan
episodes.synopsis: Coupled with the military's cover-up of a previous incident, the shocking discovery inside the wall causes a stir. Elsewhere, while the new Scout recruits are held for observation, a surprising threat appears.

episodes.title: I'm Home
episodes.synopsis: With the appearance of Titans within Wall Rose, Sasha and Conny ride as messengers to warn their villages of the impending threat.

episodes.title: Southwestward
episodes.synopsis: The Scouts search for a hole in the wall while Eren and the others learn that someone close may be hiding all the answers.

episodes.title: Soldier
episodes.synopsis: Unarmed and overwhelmed by the Titan assault on the castle, the only hope for the Scouts may lie in a promise and a secret.

episodes.title: Historia
episodes.synopsis: Utgard Castle comes crumbling down as Ymir desperately battles the Titans. Now, Christa must fulfill the promise they made long ago during winter training.

episodes.title: Warrior
episodes.synopsis: Following the battle, the Scouts regroup atop the wall only to find more questions than answers. Before they leave for Trost to get medical attention, Reiner must fulfill what he came to do.

episodes.title: Close Combat
episodes.synopsis: With a new enemy revealed, Eren and the Scouts fight back using all the techniques at their disposal. However, the Armored and Colossal Titans have other plans in mind.

episodes.title: The Hunters
episodes.synopsis: Lacking a way to pursue the Titans, Mikasa, Armin, and Hannes reflect on Eren's tenacity and determination as they recover from battle and wait for reinforcements.

episodes.title: Opening
episodes.synopsis: As the Scouts rally and charge in pursuit, Reiner loses sight of his real personality while him and the others are trapped in the giant forest until nightfall.

episodes.title: Children
episodes.synopsis: When their group finally flees, Ymir must ask herself whether to lie or stay true to herself, even if it means ruining the lives and future of those she cares about.

episodes.title: Charge
episodes.synopsis: While the recruits attempt to reason with Bertholdt, Commander Erwin charges forth in a desperate strategy to topple the Armored Titan.

episodes.title: Scream
episodes.synopsis: Eren's confrontation with the Smiling Titan raises questions about his powers, but any answers will come at a cost.

seasons.title: Temporada 3: Insurreição Real & Retomada da Muralha Maria
seasons.synopsis: A Divisão de Reconhecimento derruba o falso governo real e trava uma batalha desesperada para chegar ao porão da família Yeager.

episodes.title: Smoke Signal
episodes.synopsis: After barely surviving Eren's recovery, a rising threat from the shadows puts everyone's lives in danger again.

episodes.title: Pain
episodes.synopsis: The Scouts take a stand against a new enemy, but it's not just Titans they'll be fighting anymore.

episodes.title: Old Story
episodes.synopsis: Historia and Erwin look back on their past, revealing a shady government with a hidden agenda and inspiration for an uprising.

episodes.title: Trust
episodes.synopsis: On the run and running out of time, the Scouts must entrust their lives to others if they plan on surviving.

episodes.title: Reply
episodes.synopsis: Erwin pleads his case for the Scouts to be spared, but an unforeseen announcement puts the fate of humanity at risk.

episodes.title: Sin
episodes.synopsis: While sins of the past reveal new truths, both sides prepare for the upcoming showdown before they run out of time.

episodes.title: Wish
episodes.synopsis: As battle breaks out, Historia makes a shocking decision which leads to catastrophe.

episodes.title: Outside the Walls of Orvud District
episodes.synopsis: When everything falls apart, Eren must believe in himself to save his friends. But Eren alone may not be enough to stop the impending doom.

episodes.title: Ruler of the Walls
episodes.synopsis: Desperate to stop the approaching monstrosity, the Scouts resort to unconventional tactics before it destroys everything in its path.

episodes.title: Friends
episodes.synopsis: Kenny recalls the life which has brought him to death's door, but he gets to decide whether to live on or not.

episodes.title: Bystander
episodes.synopsis: Having seen a glimpse of his father's memories, Eren attempts to track down a man hoping they might shed some light on his father's secrets.

episodes.title: Night of the Battle to Retake the Wall
episodes.synopsis: The Scouts gather for a feisty feast before leaving to retake Wall Maria to uncover what's hidden in the basement once and for all.

episodes.title: Primal Desires - The Battle for Trost (9)
episodes.synopsis: A Divisão de Reconhecimento derruba o falso governo real e trava uma batalha desesperada para chegar ao porão da família Yeager. (Capítulo 13 de Temporada 3: Insurreição Real & Retomada da Muralha Maria: Primal Desires - The Battle for Trost (9)).

episodes.synopsis: A Divisão de Reconhecimento derruba o falso governo real e trava uma batalha desesperada para chegar ao porão da família Yeager. (Capítulo 22 de Temporada 3: Insurreição Real & Retomada da Muralha Maria: The Defeated - 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (6)).

seasons.title: Temporada 4: The Final Season — Marley & Paradis
seasons.synopsis: Do outro lado do oceano, a guerra de Marley revela a verdade geopolítica do mundo antes do ataque implacável de Eren em Liberio.

episodes.title: The Other Side of the Sea
episodes.synopsis: As Marley battles the Mid-East Alliance to end a four-year war, a group of Warrior candidates on the front lines compete to be the successor of the Armored Titan.

episodes.title: Midnight Train
episodes.synopsis: Though glad the war is over, both the Eldian Warriors and Marley brass realize that neither have a future unless they finish the job of retaking the Founding Titan.

episodes.title: The Door of Hope
episodes.synopsis: Reiner reflects on his past, remembering what pushed him to become a Warrior and keep moving forward when all hope was lost.

episodes.title: From One Hand to Another
episodes.synopsis: A sudden visit from the Tybur family shakes up the Marleyan military. Meanwhile, Falco smuggles letters for a friend and helps two old comrades reunite.

episodes.title: Declaration of War
episodes.synopsis: While Willy Tybur reveals the truth in a shocking speech to the world, tensions rise behind the stage as Eren and Reiner meet face to face.

episodes.title: The War Hammer Titan
episodes.synopsis: Eren's rampage is thwarted by the War Hammer Titan whose tenacity leaves him stumped. With Marley's military joining the fight, he'll be hard-pressed to survive on his own.

episodes.title: Assault
episodes.synopsis: The forces of Paradis begin their assault, but the Warriors stand their ground. As Marley troops close in around them, Eren struggles to break the War Hammer's defenses.

episodes.title: Assassin's Bullet
episodes.synopsis: With no Titans left to threaten their escape, the Scouts retreat on the airship. Determined to make them pay for trampling on her home, Gabi chases after with gun in hand.

episodes.title: Brave Volunteers
episodes.synopsis: As Paradis deals with the aftermath of the raid on Liberio, Armin looks back into the past to meeting the volunteer soldiers who reshaped their world.

episodes.title: A Sound Argument
episodes.synopsis: Two years ago, Paradis welcomed their first visitor who was surprised to see one of their own. Obtaining their help will be critical in a three-part plan to protect Paradis.

episodes.title: Deceiver
episodes.synopsis: Trapped on the world's most dangerous island, Falco and Gabi will do anything to survive. Elsewhere, the public demands answers when they learn the savior of Paradis has been detained.

episodes.title: Guides
episodes.synopsis: While Hange and Pyxis piece together Zeke's true intentions, tension builds outside HQ where Armin and Mikasa plead for permission to speak with Eren.

episodes.title: Children of the Forest
episodes.synopsis: Gabi and Falco seek out a fellow Marleyan who is surprised to see Warrior candidates. The truth of what happened at Ragako may shed some light on Zeke's secret plans.

episodes.title: Savagery
episodes.synopsis: Armin and Mikasa speak with Eren but are astounded by what he says. In the forest, Levi considers feeding the Beast Titan to someone new, but Zeke has other plans in mind.

episodes.title: Sole Salvation
episodes.synopsis: A look into Zeke's past shows his struggle to become a Warrior. His plans to end the suffering of all Eldians stem from a chance friendship made in his youth.

episodes.title: Above and Below
episodes.synopsis: With the Jaegerists now in charge, Zeke's master plan is revealed. But before it is put in motion, Eren recruits help to flush out any invaders in their midst.

seasons.title: Temporada 5: O Estrondo & Os Capítulos Finais
seasons.synopsis: Eren Yeager desperta o poder do Titã Fundador e inicia o Estrondo, forçando seus antigos companheiros a uma aliança impossível.

episodes.title: To You, 2,000 Years in the Future -The Fall of Zhiganshina (1)
episodes.synopsis: Eren Yeager desperta o poder do Titã Fundador e inicia o Estrondo, forçando seus antigos companheiros a uma aliança impossível. (Capítulo 1 de Temporada 5: O Estrondo & Os Capítulos Finais: To You, 2,000 Years in the Future -The Fall of Zhiganshina (1)).

seasons.title: Temporada 1: Prólogo da Guerra & A Lâmina de Askeladd
seasons.synopsis: Consumido pelo desejo de vingar a morte de seu pai Thors, o jovem Thorfinn segue o bando mercenário de Askeladd na invasão da Inglaterra.

episodes.title: Somewhere not here
episodes.synopsis: Thorfinn, a boy living in Iceland, longs for adventure and is eager to know more about the world. He dreams of a land of paradise called Vinland that he hears about from the adventurer Leif, while he leads his peaceful life with this father Thors, a former warrior. One day, Thors saves a runaway slave and sets a series of events in motion. This is the story of a true warrior in an age of turmoil.

episodes.title: Sword
episodes.synopsis: In the year 1002, the war between England and Denmark was intensifying. One day, the Jomsvikings pay a visit to Thorfinn's village in order to bring back Thors, their former commander, to prepare for the impending battle. Thors is forced to join the war in order to protect the villagers from being taken hostage, and must face his accursed past in order to save his family and his village.

episodes.title: Troll
episodes.synopsis: Askeladd, the leader of a Viking army of a hundred men, receives orders from Floki of the Jomsvikings to kill Thors, who was once known as the Troll of Jom. However, the villagers, completely unaware of the order, buzz with excitement as they prepare for their first battle. Thorfinn also joins in the excitement. Thors and his men are about to embark on a difficult sea journey to England.

episodes.title: A True Warrior
episodes.synopsis: Thors and his men fall for Askeladd’s trap and faces a dangerous situation, but Thors defeats many of Askeladd’s men with his overpowering strength. However, Thors knows that it will be difficult to save everyone, including his son, who’ve been living in a peaceful village their entire lives, and makes a tough decision.

episodes.title: The Troll's Son
episodes.synopsis: After Askeladd kills Thorfinn’s father Thors, Thorfinn hides inside Thor’s ship and bides his time until the opportunity to take revenge. However, life on the ship is harsh without any food or water, and Thorfinn grows weaker day by day. One day, Thorfinn, armed with his sword, attempt to attack Askeladd in his sleep...

episodes.title: The Journey Begins
episodes.synopsis: Thorfinn goes to battle for the first time as a member of Askeladd’s army. After witnessing the harsh reality of the war to conquer England first-hand, Thorfinn tries to run away, but later throws himself into battle in order to get revenge for his father by defeating Askeladd. One night, Thorfinn gets wounded in battle, and is saved by a mother and daughter living in a village by the sea.

episodes.title: Normanni
episodes.synopsis: Askeladd withdraws temporarily from the war against England. While searching for a new source of income, he encounters a skirmish among the Franks and hatches a plot to steal their treasure. Askeladd sends 16 years old Thorfinn, who has grown up into a cold-hearted Viking, ahead as a messenger.

episodes.title: Beyond the Edge of the Sea
episodes.synopsis: After capturing the treasure from the Franks, Askeladd’s men return to the village of Gorm on the Jutland Peninsula in Denmark to pass the winter. Thorfinn challenges Askeladd to a duel as a reward for bringing him the head of the captain of the clan of Franks. Even though Thorfinn has grown in skill through his experience in battle, he is still no match for Askeladd.

episodes.title: The Battle of London Bridge
episodes.synopsis: In October 1013, King Sweyn leads a fleet of Danish and Viking ships in an attempt to take London Bridge of England. Askeladd’s army, hired by the army of Denmark, was among them. However, after the betrayal of Thorkell the Tall, a Viking known for his overpowering strength, London Bridge has become impregnable. Askeladd tells Thorfinn he’ll reward him with a duel if he’s able to kill Thorkell.

episodes.title: Ragnarok
episodes.synopsis: Askeladd’s army separates from the army of Denmark and attacks a village 100 km to the west. Thorfinn leaves the soldiers behind in disgust and climbs up a hill overlooking the village, where he pledges revenge for his father. However, he encounters Askeladd sitting in the darkness, who tells him about "Britannia", the aging of the world, and Ragnarok, the final battle.

episodes.title: A Gamble
episodes.synopsis: Thorkell takes Canute hostage and follows after the main army of Denmark. Ragnar objects to Thorkell’s plan to take on the entire army of Denmark, boasting 16,000 soldiers, with only 500 men. Thorkell then begins to tell Ragnar the story of Valhalla, the pride of Normans, a place where only those who die in battle can go.

episodes.title: The Land on the Far Bank
episodes.synopsis: Askeladd and his men continue their march to escape from Thorkell. However, their march comes to a halt at the Severn River. Askeladd hands a letter to an old man operating a ferry across the river and tells him to deliver the letter to the other side immediately. As soon as he hears the addressee’s name, the old man sets off in his boat.

episodes.title: Child of a Hero
episodes.synopsis: Askeladd crosses the river and escapes from Thorkell into Wales with Canute. However, Askeladd’s men are ambushed by a group of soldiers hiding behind the boulders at the border of the kingdom of Brycheiniog. Askeladd attempts to negotiate with their messenger, and reveals his plan.

episodes.title: The Light of Dawn
episodes.synopsis: Askeladd and his men change course and decide to return to Gainsborough, by crossing through the Earldom of Mercia in the midst of a harsh snowstorm, where the main army of Denmark awaits. The men spot a small village in the blizzard, and make their move.

episodes.title: After Yule
episodes.synopsis: After losing Canute, Thorkell decides to halt his advance in central England. Thorkell hears that the end of the war between Denmark and England is near, and bemoans the end of the war. However, he later gets wind of an interesting piece of news.

episodes.title: History of Beasts
episodes.synopsis: Askeladd and his men are attacked by the English army in the village where they had planned to camp during the winter. Askeladd captures their captain and interrogates him to find out how the English knew where they were, and discovers that Thorkell is fast approaching. The news of Thorkell’s arrival sends waves of shock among Askeladd’s followers.

episodes.title: Servant
episodes.synopsis: Askeladd’s men continued their march to escape Thorkell. However, Torgrim and his friends were hatching a plot to switch sides and join Thorkell, taking Canute with them. Torgrim finally launches his rebellion and corners Askeladd, negotiating with him to hand over Canute, then Thorkell arrives in the midst of the confusion.

episodes.title: Out of the Cradle
episodes.synopsis: Thorfinn and Thorkell agree to have a duel over the fate of Askeladd. Thorkell looks forward to facing off against Thors’s son, Thorfinn, and asks him what a true warrior really is. Meanwhile, Canute is suddenly ambushed while he attempts to escape, and has a dream about a certain individual.

episodes.title: United Front
episodes.synopsis: Thorfinn suffers a serious injury in his fight against Thorkell. Thorfinn is told to think about what he has to do to beat Thorkell. Askeladd treats Thorfinn’s wounds so that he may fight again someday, and proposes a joint strategy to help the two of them survive longer.

episodes.title: Crown
episodes.synopsis: After the fighting dies down, Canute takes in Askeladd and Thorkell as his followers, and returns to Gainsborough. Canute goes through an awakening when he realizes the meaning of love in the aftermath of Ragnar’s death. Canute throws away what little feelings he had left for his father, and joins Askeladd in plotting to assassinate King Sweyn.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.synopsis: Canute's party arrives in York to attend the Imperial Council. Although Canute had wanted to strike out against King Sweyn.

episodes.title: Lone Wolf
episodes.synopsis: Thorfinn begins his duel against Askeladd with Canute and Thorkell as witnesses. However, Thorfinn is unable to strike as he stands overwhelmed by the extraordinary mood that overtakes Askeladd after Bjorn's departure.

episodes.title: Miscalculation
episodes.synopsis: After the assassination attempt on Canute's life, rumors spread through York saying that the king is trying to kill Canute. As a result, the king is unable to issue any orders that would put Canute in harm, and Askeladd is pleased that everything is proceeding as planned. However, the tables turn when King Sweyn speaks. Meanwhile, Thorfinn is sent to prison as punishment for disturbing the peace.

episodes.title: End of the Prologue
episodes.synopsis: As the Imperial Council proceeds, Askeladd is shocked by the news of Wales. As he gets called by the king, he makes a last stand.

seasons.title: Temporada 2: Arco da Fazenda & O Verdadeiro Guerreiro
seasons.synopsis: Escravizado na fazenda de Ketil ao lado de Einar, Thorfinn confronta o vazio deixado pela violência e descobre o significado de 'Eu não tenho inimigos'.

episodes.title: Slave
episodes.synopsis: Einar lives peacefully in northern England with his mother and sister, but then one day, their village comes under attack.

episodes.title: Ketil's farm
episodes.synopsis: Einar and Thoriffin are told to convert a wild forest into a wheat field; and if they succeed, they will have a chance to buy their own freedom.

episodes.title: Snake
episodes.synopsis: The farm guards convince Ketil's son that he needs to make his first killing to become a man.

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.synopsis: After everything that's happened, Einar asks Thorfinn if he's ever fought in a war - and if he's ever killed a man.

episodes.title: The Path of Blood
episodes.synopsis: After the sudden turn of events, young Canute must rise up to claim the throne to a kingdom much reduced and under attack.

episodes.title: I Want a Horse
episodes.synopsis: Thorfinn and Einar are working themselves to the bone to clear the forest, but there's only so much they can do without the help of horses.

episodes.title: Iron Fist Ketil
episodes.synopsis: Thieves have been stealing food from Ketil's farm. Meanwhile, Ketil's eldest son Thorgil returns home.

episodes.title: An Empty Man
episodes.synopsis: Thorfinn has nightmares almost every night, but he can never remember what he dreamed about - and that bothers him.

episodes.title: Oath
episodes.synopsis: Thorfinn wakes up in a peaceful place and sees his father again. But then things quickly turn dark, and Thorfinn must face his painful past.

episodes.title: Cursed Head
episodes.synopsis: Finally, after three long years, Einar and Thorfinn chop down the final tree in the forest. With hopes in their hearts, they talk about the future.

episodes.title: The King and the Sword
episodes.synopsis: While in Jeilling, Ketil, Thorgil, and Olmar meet a man named Leif Erikson who is searching for Thorfinn, the son of his close friend.

episodes.title: For The Love That Was Lost
episodes.synopsis: Olmar feels insulted by Canute's messenger and, encouraged by his older brother Thorgil, takes matters into his own hands.

episodes.title: Dark Clouds
episodes.synopsis: Einar says that even if he gains his freedom, he wants to stay near Arnheid. Snake hears news of a slave who killed his owners, and is now on the run.

episodes.title: Freedom
episodes.synopsis: A runaway slave appears on Ketil's farm, claiming to be Arnheid's husband. But before he can free her, he is confronted by Snake.

episodes.title: Storm
episodes.synopsis: Arnheid comes to the fortress where Gardar is imprisoned. She wants to see her husband and treat his injuries.

episodes.title: Cause
episodes.synopsis: As Snake intensifies his search, Arnheid tells Einar and Thorfinn everything she's done. Knowing the risks, Einar and Thorfinn offer to help her.

episodes.title: Way Home
episodes.synopsis: Snake strikes quickly, surprising Thorfinn with his speed and agility. As he lies wounded, Gardar thinks back on the life he shared with Arnheid.

episodes.title: The First Measure
episodes.synopsis: After returning to his farm, an exhausted Ketil starts searching for Arnheid, only to find out what happened in his absence.

episodes.title: War at Ketil's Farm
episodes.synopsis: Amidst the confusion of a peasant uprising, Thorfinn and the others try to escape, carrying a severely injured and pregnant Arnheid.

episodes.title: Pain
episodes.synopsis: As Thorfinn and Einar head to their escape, Arnheid regains consciousness and asks where are they going - and if there are slaves and wars there too.

episodes.title: Courage
episodes.synopsis: The battle has left heartbreaking casualties in its wake. Though Thorgill and Ketil's wife want to continue the fight, Canute demands their surrender.

episodes.title: Emperor of Rebellion
episodes.synopsis: Snake tries to put a stop to it, but Thorfinn insists on receiving all 100 blows from Canute's brutish guard Drott, shocking the rowdy onlookers.

episodes.title: Two Paths
episodes.synopsis: Thorfinn and Einar have said their peace, but Canute stubbornly refuses to give up Ketil's Farm. Then, Thorfinn breaks off the standoff with a decision.

episodes.title: Hometown
episodes.synopsis: At long last, Thorfinn returns to Iceland and finds a moment of happiness, reunited with his loved ones. But soon, he opens up about his next journey.

seasons.title: Temporada 1: A Heresia Heliocêntrica & A Chama da Verdade
seasons.synopsis: Na Europa do século XV, prodígios e eruditos arriscam a própria vida perante a Inquisição para provar matematicamente que a Terra gira em torno do Sol.

episodes.title: Heliocentrism. How about that?
episodes.synopsis: A gifted young student plans to study theology at university, but his true passion is astronomy. One day, he meets a mysterious scholar named Hubert.

episodes.title: And Now... I'm Going To Move The Earth
episodes.synopsis: Rafal is intrigued by Hubert's heliocentric theory. Later, Hubert is arrested by an inquisitor but he gives Rafal a pendant before being whisked away.

episodes.title: I... Believe in Heliocentrism
episodes.synopsis: Nowack convinces Potocki to admit to Rafal's heresy. Once arrested, Rafal is given a choice; recant his belief in heliocentrism or submit to torture.

episodes.title: The Fact That This World Is Far More Beautiful Than Heaven
episodes.synopsis: The duelist Oczy wishes for death so he can escape his hopeless world and go to heaven. His colleague finds meaning in life by observing the stars.

episodes.title: Even If I Die... This World Will Continue
episodes.synopsis: Gras aborts the mission, placing himself and Oczy in mortal danger from Nowak. They both flee from the mountains, where they find a stone chest.

episodes.title: Move... The World
episodes.synopsis: Oczy seeks the help of Badeni, the demoted monk who incurred the Church's wrath by turning his curiosity to the riddles of the sky.

episodes.title: Matters Of The Truth
episodes.synopsis: Gifted scholar Jolenta suffers discrimination as the only girl at an astronomy institute. Badeni seeks resources to prove the heliocentric theory.

episodes.title: We Must Become Icarus
episodes.synopsis: Badeni offers Jolenta a chance to pursue the truth of the skies, but she is overcome with fear. Afterward, she overhears bold words from Count Piast.

episodes.title: This Is What It Means... To Learn Something, I Think
episodes.synopsis: A middle-aged Piast vows to prove his professor's geocentric model. In the present, he agrees to let Badeni use his records — on one condition.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.synopsis: Oczy tells Badeni that he is learning to read and write. Later, Badeni's claim that knowledge should be held by a select few bothers a fellow monk.

episodes.title: Terror
episodes.synopsis: Nowak gives two rookie inquisitors a terrifying first taste of their new roles. Badeni meets with Jolenta and tells her he has completed his theory.

episodes.title: Heliocentrism Is My Faith
episodes.synopsis: Nowak asks Badeni to show him his research. He inspects Badeni's premises but doesn't find anything incriminating — until he spots a certain item.

episodes.title: Freedom
episodes.synopsis: In a medical area within the inquisition chamber, a wounded Oczy awakes to see Nowak, who has kept him alive in hopes of extracting information.

episodes.title: Tonight's Sky
episodes.synopsis: Badeni must choose between revealing the location of the heretical documents of the heliocentric theory or prolonging Oczy's torture at Nowak's hands.

episodes.title: Is It...My Turn?
episodes.synopsis: Nowak believes his beloved daughter has been executed as a heretic. Father Grabowski comes across a letter from Badeni containing an unusual request.

episodes.title: It's Time to Begin the Operation
episodes.synopsis: Twenty-five years later, Captain Schmidt of the extremist Heretic Liberation Front infiltrates a church and steals an important item.

episodes.title: I Could Make a Lot of Money With This Book...Maybe
episodes.synopsis: A young nomad woman haunted by poverty devotes her life to obtaining wealth. One night, she discovers the book that Frei hid in the abandoned village.

episodes.title: To Liberate Information
episodes.synopsis: Bishop Antoni orders Draka to hand over the book, but Schmidt's men suddenly intervene. Determined to change her fate, she takes a bold action.

episodes.title: Morality Is Something You Find When You're Lost
episodes.synopsis: Hoping to track down the people who stole the book, an inquisitor seeks advice from Nowak, who now spends his days drowning his sorrows.

episodes.title: I Love Heliocentrism
episodes.synopsis: As the Heretic Liberation Front prepares to depart, Jolenta entrusts Draka with a letter. Soon after, Nowak and the inquisitors approach the barn.

episodes.title: The Times Are Changing
episodes.synopsis: Schmidt and the other regroup with their Liberation Front comrades and begin printing the book. However, a traitor brings their operation to a halt.

episodes.title: Neither Of You Will Be Known to History
episodes.synopsis: As Nowak's group attacks the Liberation Front, Draka and Schmidt begin their escape. Upon reaching the town, Draka makes a proposition to Bishop Antoni.

episodes.title: Comrades
episodes.synopsis: A deluded Nowak turns against Antoni and attempts to burn down the church. Draka fights back and escapes but incurs a terrible wound.

episodes.title: Thaumazein
episodes.synopsis: Albert goes to deliver an order of bread to a church. While there, he encounters a mysterious priest who encourages him to confess his sins.
Albert leaves the academic gathering and returns home to an awful sight. In the present, the priest gives Albert advice and makes his own confession.

seasons.title: Temporada 1: Os Mistérios da Corte Interna
seasons.synopsis: Maomao, uma brilhante boticária obcecada por venenos e farmacologia, desvenda conspirações letais nos bastidores do Palácio Imperial.

episodes.title: Maomao
episodes.synopsis: After being kidnapped and forced to work as a servant in the rear palace, former apothecary Maomao inadvertently draws the attention of the higher ranks when she investigates what's causing the emperor's infant heirs to fall mysteriously ill.

episodes.title: Chilly Apothecary
episodes.synopsis: Maomao tries to settle into her promotion to lady-in-waiting and food taster but struggles to fend off both boredom and the overly familiar Jinshi. That is, until she gets an assignment of her dreams: to concoct an aphrodisiac.

episodes.title: The Unsettling Matter of the Spirit
episodes.synopsis: Tasked with investigating a ghostly woman dancing nightly on the palace walls, Maomao finds a sleepwalking Concubine Fuyou. But with no medicinal cure for sleepwalking, she's forced to dig deeper to find the real reason behind Fuyou's affliction.

episodes.title: The Threat
episodes.synopsis: Under direct orders from the emperor himself, Maomao tries to care for an ailing Concubine Lihua but finds her work impeded by Lihua's own ladies-in-waiting.

episodes.title: Covert Operations
episodes.synopsis: A eunuch stricken by a curse comes begging for aid. Meanwhile, the rear palace buzzes with excitement as everyone prepares for the upcoming garden party, and Gyokuyou's ladies-in-waiting aren't about to let Maomao get away without dressing her up.

episodes.title: The Garden Party
episodes.synopsis: Maomao does her best to navigate the complex social situations at the garden party, including meeting the other Upper First rank concubines. But once she settles down to do her work as a food-taster, she discovers a surprise in a bowl of soup.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.synopsis: Gaoshun goes to Maomao to get her help in resolving the events of the garden party. Later, Xiaolan explains the purpose of the hairpins Maomao was gifted, and Maomao makes a deal with Lihaku in order to finally visit home.

episodes.title: Wheat Stalks
episodes.synopsis: Maomao's peaceful morning at home is interrupted when she's called in to investigate an apparent double suicide at one of the local brothels.

episodes.title: Suicide or Murder?
episodes.synopsis: An older acquaintance of Jinshi's dies while drinking at a party. A servant's body turns up in a moat. Both deaths are written off as self-inflicted, but Maomao's keen observations tell her that there's more to both stories.

episodes.title: Honey
episodes.synopsis: A tea party hosted by Lady Gyokuyou puts the politics of the rear palace at the forefront, and Maomao learns something new about Lady Lishu. His true intentions unclear, Jinshi sends Maomao to work for Lady Ah-Duo.

episodes.title: Reducing Two to One
episodes.synopsis: Maomao confronts Fengming about the dark secret she's been hiding from her noble Lady Ah-Duo.

episodes.title: The Eunuch and the Courtesan
episodes.synopsis: Discovering that Maomao's kidnappers were connected to Fengming's family, Jinshi is faced with a choice between keeping Maomao in the rear palace where he can be near her or releasing her from her service.

episodes.title: Serving in the Outer Court
episodes.synopsis: To Maomao's surprise, Jinshi brings her directly to his house instead of taking her back to the rear palace and tells her she's to work in the outer court. Not only is there much to learn, it seems there are many eyes on her as the new hire.

episodes.title: The New Pure Consort
episodes.synopsis: Ah-Duo's replacement has arrived in the rear palace, and Maomao is assigned to give a certain lecture to all four high concubines. Later, Maomao helps Lihaku investigate a warehouse explosion.

episodes.title: Raw Fish
episodes.synopsis: Gaoshun requests Maomao's help in solving an apparent poisoning case. Meanwhile, Jinshi deals with an unwelcome visitor who's taken to lingering in his office.

episodes.title: Lead
episodes.synopsis: A shack, a chest of drawers, and a fishbowl are all that a talented metalworker leaves to his three sons upon his death. Maomao is assigned to investigate how these strange inheritances all fit together.

episodes.title: A Jaunt Around Town
episodes.synopsis: Covering up Jinshi's otherworldly beauty is no easy task, but after Maomao takes the challenge head-on, she's surprised when she's also asked to don the disguise of a noblewoman and escort "Jinka" outside the palace.

episodes.title: Lakan
episodes.synopsis: Back at home, Maomao visits an annex building at the Verdigris House that hides one of the brothel's secrets. Lakan continues to antagonize Jinshi as his connection to Maomao becomes clear.

episodes.title: Chance or Something More
episodes.synopsis: Maomao, uma brilhante boticária obcecada por venenos e farmacologia, desvenda conspirações letais nos bastidores do Palácio Imperial. (Capítulo 19 de Temporada 1: Os Mistérios da Corte Interna: Chance or Something More).

episodes.title: Thornapple
episodes.synopsis: Maomao was able to stop the assassination attempt but was heavily injured in the process. However, the injuries aren't enough to stop her curiosity, driving her to confront the culprit behind the incident.

episodes.title: How to Buy Out A Contract
episodes.synopsis: Back to work at the rear palace, Maomao listens to Guen talk about his family's business. Meanwhile, Lihaku hears a rumor that that whips him into action.

episodes.title: Blue Roses
episodes.synopsis: Lakan challenges Jinshi to produce blue roses to present at the upcoming garden party, forcing Jinshi to turn once again to Maomao for her help.

episodes.title: Balsam and Woodsorrel
episodes.synopsis: No longer willing to keep running away from Lakan, Maomao decides to face off against him. She challenges him on his own turf, in a chess match.

episodes.title: Jinshi and Maomao
episodes.synopsis: Lakan must now choose a courtesan to buy out. As a high-ranking military official, he can afford to freely choose, even from one of the Three Princesses. Who will he choose? Who does Maomao really want him to choose?

seasons.title: Temporada 1: O Retorno Através da Morte
seasons.synopsis: Transportado para outro mundo, Subaru Natsuki descobre que possui apenas uma habilidade: voltar no tempo toda vez que morre de forma trágica.

episodes.title: The End of the Beginning and the Beginning of the End
episodes.synopsis: In the series opening double episode, Natsuki Subaru is summoned to a alternate world on his way home one day. At first, he's enamored with this new fantasy world, but the cute girl summoned him? Nowhere to be found. He quickly learns that he doesn't have any of the powers as a gang surrounds him. Right at that moment, she appears…

episodes.title: Reunion with the Witch
episodes.synopsis: After being attacked by someone the first time, sliced open by Elsa the second time, and stabbed in the back by punks the third time, Subaru should have been dead, but found himself back where he started in the same parallel world every time. He finally realizes he's acquired the power to go back to the time and place he started from, which he calls "Return by Death." In hopes of changing the fate awaiting Felt, Sate

episodes.title: Starting Life from Zero in Another World
episodes.synopsis: Subaru attempts to buy the insignia from Felt and return it to Satella before Elsa arrives at the loot house... but Satella arrives before the negotiations are complete, and Elsa still attacks them.

episodes.title: The Happy Roswaal Mansion Family
episodes.synopsis: After being badly wounded by Elsa, Subaru somehow survived and awoke in the mansion of Margrave Mathers, in the Kingdom of Lugunica.

episodes.title: The Morning of Our Promise Is Still Distant
episodes.synopsis: Subaru now lives and works in Roswaal's mansion, working with Ram and Rem, and finally getting Emilia to agree to a date with him. But the day of their promised date never comes as Subaru keeps going back to the day he first awoke in the mansion. He's confused at the thought that he Returned by Death despite having no memory of experiencing anything deadly, but he's determined to repeat his previous actions up to the

episodes.title: The Sound of Chains
episodes.synopsis: Subaru's first day at the Roswaal mansion begins for the third time. The first time, he grew weak and died of unknown reasons in his sleep, and the second time, he was killed by an attacker. The sound of chains that he heard as he died the second time replays in his mind, waking him in a terrified, cold sweat. He has no idea what the killer is after, let alone who it is, so he makes a plan to leave the mansion on the

episodes.title: Natsuki Subaru's Restart
episodes.synopsis: Rem knocks Subaru down and tortures him. She suspects that Subaru belongs to a faction against Emilia, and states that he has a smell of witch before killing him. Subaru is revived once again in the mansion, and meets Ram and Rem again, with fear. Emilia worries about him, realizing he is in trouble; Subaru tries to tell her about his deaths and revivals, but just as he begins, a black shadow seemingly with hands ove

episodes.title: I Cried, Cried My Lungs Out, and Stopped Crying
episodes.synopsis: Subaru awakens again after being killed, once again. Subaru becomes so intent and focused on getting past this route that he over exerts and exhausts himself, which leads him towards a potential new ending.

episodes.title: The Meaning of Courage
episodes.synopsis: Subaru visits the village with Ram and Rem with the purpose of finding the the culprit. When the three return from the village, Roswaal leaves for the night, which did not happen in the previous timelines. Subaru sees Beatrice to confirm that he was cursed and to locate where it was applied to on his body. Having traced the curse to the dog that bit him, Subaru realizes that the children are in danger and that night,

episodes.title: Fanatical Methods Like a Demon
episodes.synopsis: Subaru awakens after his battle in the forest with the beasts.  He learns from Beatrice that his curse has not been entirely removed.  During the battle, the beasts continually cursed him over and over and it is too complicated to remove.  After learning this, Rem set off into the forest in order to kill the beasts --can Subaru and Ram get to her before her demon side leaves her too far gone?

episodes.title: Rem
episodes.synopsis: In the past, Ram and Rem lived in a demon village where the birth of twins is considered taboo. Ram was a prodigy, while Rem struggled with life. One day, Ram had her horn cut off and Rem had been blaming herself since then. Back in the present, Rem regains her senses after Subaru knocked her unconscious. Subaru, Ram, and Rem run away from the Mabeasts, and they encounter the dog shaman behind the attack. Subaru stay

episodes.title: Return to the Capital
episodes.synopsis: At the order of the council of elders that manages Lugunica in the king's absence, Wilhelm and Felix visit Roswaal's mansion as emissaries. Emilia is required in the imperial capital right away, so Subaru asks her to take him along. Emilia tells him this won't be a pleasure trip, but a push from Rem and Roswaal ends in her agreement, so Emilia and Subaru head to the capital. Now all of the candidates to be Lugunica's

episodes.title: Self-Proclaimed Knight Natsuki Subaru
episodes.synopsis: As Emilia joins Priscilla, Crusch, and Anastasia in a meeting of the royal selection participants, Reinhard enters the hall with Felt. According to a new prophecy seen on the Dragon Stone, there are five priestesses with the potential to be the kingdom's next ruler. Reinhard announces that Felt is the fifth priestess, meaning it's time to formally begin the royal selection, but Felt refuses to have any part in it.

episodes.title: The Sickness Called Despair
episodes.synopsis: "I just wanted to protect her. That feeling wasn't a lie. Where did I go wrong?" Rejected by the one who meant more to him than anything, Subaru is still unable to recognize that he may have done something irreversible. He then finds out that some disturbing movement has been detected within Roswaal's domain, where Emilia and the others are. He's certain that he can save them somehow, so in spite of Rem and Crusch's

episodes.title: The Outside of Madness
episodes.synopsis: Upon returning to Roswaal's mansion, Subaru is greeted by an unbelievable sight and wails that this was not what he wanted to happen. Stricken with despair, everything before Subaru starts to go white as, finally, he hears a voice: "You were too late."

episodes.title: The Greed of a Pig
episodes.synopsis: Subaru wakes up in front of the appa shop once again. Feeling boxed in on all sides due to his own lack of power to change the situation, he seeks the help of others. First, he seeks the help of Crush, who flatly declines any further involvement passed her contractual obligation of healing Subaru. His requests to Anastasia and Priscilla similarly go unanswered despite his pleas. Having wasted too much time, Subaru de

episodes.title: Disgrace in the Extreme
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious figure appears before Subaru and his traveling companions. As the looming beast attacks with a deafening bellow amidst the darkness and fog, Rem determines that it will be too difficult to escape...

episodes.title: From Zero
episodes.synopsis: Subaru laments that he could not do anything or save anyone, and has no options left. Exhausted, he suddenly takes off running at full speed as if he's made a decision...

episodes.title: Battle Against the White Whale
episodes.synopsis: To save Emilia, Subaru approaches Crusch to negotiate the formation of an alliance. His terms are a bit difficult for Crusch to believe, but she can see that Subaru isn't lying.

episodes.title: Wilhelm van Astrea
episodes.synopsis: Subaru has devoted everything he had, and done all he could do. His passion has captured Crusch's heart, as well as Anastasia's cooperation, and they all enter into the battle against the White Whale together.

episodes.title: A Wager That Defies Despair
episodes.synopsis: Subaru and Rem are at a loss for words. The battle against the White Whale, which seemed to be going in their favor through attrition, suddenly took on completely different proportions. With their tactical superiority and advantage quickly dwindling, the combined forces all but get tangled up in the threads of despair. That's when Subaru decides to yell out his next move...

episodes.title: A Flash of Sloth
episodes.synopsis: With the battle against the White Whale now over, the mercenary force setting up the blockade of the road comes back, Julius at the lead. His arrival gives rise to mixed feelings for Subaru, but after Julius sincerely thanks him for ridding the world of the monster, Subaru finds it in himself to apologize for his past behavior. The group now looks forward, ready to enter the Mathers domain...

episodes.title: Nefarious Sloth
episodes.synopsis: The group is making its way in the Mathers domain when suddenly everyone but Subaru disappears and a strange, suffocating atmosphere seeps through the forest. He quickly figures out it is nothing but an illusion, and with help from Julius on the other side, dispels the barrier for everyone caught in it. However, arriving at the village doesn't make convincing the residents to evacuate easy. Time is running out, and t

episodes.title: The Self-Proclaimed Knight and the Greatest Knight
episodes.synopsis: Subaru devises a new plan to correct the mistake of the blank letter sent to the manor, encourage the evacuation of the villagers and move Emilia away from her current location. With these preparations complete, he enacts the second part of his plan designed to cut off the Fingers before severing the Unseen Hand once and for all.

episodes.title: That's All This Story Is About
episodes.synopsis:
Emilia is hurriedly ushered to the capital along with the villagers under the orders of a mysterious benefactor while escorted by a rag-tag group of individuals from various and opposing factions. She has but one question on her mind: who could this man be and why would he go so far?

Meanwhile, Subaru and Julius face off against the Archbishop of Sin Betelgeuse for the ultimate time. Unfortunately, he is very persis

seasons.title: Temporada 1: Ecossistema & Gastronomia da Masmorra
seasons.synopsis: Para resgatar sua irmã Falin devorada por um Dragão Vermelho sem dinheiro para provisões, Laios e seu grupo decidem cozinhar os monstros da masmorra.

episodes.title: Hot Pot/Tart
episodes.synopsis: After a crushing loss, Laios, Marcille, and Chilchuck quickly re-enter the dungeon to save Falin, but this time, they have a foolproof survival plan.

episodes.title: Roast Basilisk/Omelet/Kakiage
episodes.synopsis: After waking up to a tantalizing smell, Marcille receives a lecture from Senshi on a balanced diet. The crew helps an adventurer poisoned by a basilisk.

episodes.title: Living Armor
episodes.synopsis: Laios and crew access a hidden area guarded by mysterious Living Armor, who appear to be protecting something potentially delicious.

episodes.title: Stewed Cabbage/Orcs
episodes.synopsis: Reaching the third level of the dungeon, Senshi leads the crew to his secret vegetable garden. Later, they are accosted by a band of angry, desperate orcs.

episodes.title: Snacks/Sorbet
episodes.synopsis: As another group of adventurers discovers a treasure box, a swarm of bone-chilling ghosts chases Laios and his crew. Senshi, however, has a sweet plan.

episodes.title: Court Cuisine/ Boiled in Salt Water
episodes.synopsis: A starving Laios angers a mysterious elf while hunting for food in Living Paintings. Later Chilchuck finds himself trapped with a crabby Mimic.

episodes.title: Kelpie/Porridge/Broiled with Sauce
episodes.synopsis: Something's fishy on this new dungeon level! The crew crosses a treacherous lake, encountering vicous seafood and fallen adventurers along the way.

episodes.title: Raspberries/Grilled Meat
episodes.synopsis: Marcille recalls when she first met Falin as young students. After a quick wash-up, an inadvertent misstep lands her in deep water with an angry spirit.

episodes.title: Tentacles/Stew
episodes.synopsis: The smell of meat lures in uninvited guests — among them, a familiar face emerges. To move forward, they must work together to defeat the Undine.

episodes.title: Giant Frogs/Aboveground
episodes.synopsis: The crew avoids a stinging descent to the castle town, where the Red Dragon lurks. But to defeat it, they need a tight plan — and a morale-boosting meal.

episodes.title: Red Dragon I
episodes.synopsis: The crew finally faces the Red Dragon, but their grand strategy quickly unravels. With the beast's fury escalating, who will get the final bite?

episodes.title: Red Dragon II
episodes.synopsis: A desperate search inside the dragon's stomach leads to a gruesome discovery, revealing that resurrection magic alone won't be enough to restore Falin.

episodes.title: Red Dragon III/Good Medicine
episodes.synopsis: Falin starts acting strange in the middle of the night, leading Laios and crew to a menacing figure who wants them gone.

episodes.title: Sea Serpent
episodes.synopsis: Back in the upper dungeon level, Kabru and crew wake up to find their supplies missing and are ambushed on their way back to the surface.

episodes.title: Dryad/Cockatrice
episodes.synopsis: Trapped in the dungeon, a concerned Senshi cooks up a nourishing meal for the famished crew — giving Marcille enough energy to come up with a plan.

episodes.title: Cleaners/Dried with Sweet Sake
episodes.synopsis: Chilchuck figures out a way to escape the dungeon, but their ascent is halted by an unexpected encounter with an old friend in dire need of sustenance.

episodes.title: Harpy/Chimera
episodes.synopsis: The parties must band together to fend off an attack by vicious Harpies — but the unexpected appearance of a transformed Falin stuns everyone.

episodes.title: Shapeshifter
episodes.synopsis: While in pursuit of Falin, Laios and crew seek shelter from a blizzard but are overrun by Shapeshifters copies of themselves. How will they spot the fakes?

episodes.title: Hag/Nightmare
episodes.synopsis: The crew is cornered by an acquaintance who demands help with a beastly problem. Later, Laios enters Marcille's nightmare and discovers her greatest fear.

episodes.title: Ice Golem/Barometz
episodes.synopsis: Izutsumi proves to be a useful ally despite her lousy table manners — and aversion to eating monsters. But the crew's kindness slowly opens her up.

episodes.title: Egg/The Golden Country
episodes.synopsis: With the dungeon's fate hanging in the balance, Kabru negotiates with the elves. Meanwhile, a ghost drags Laios and crew into the cursed Golden Country.

episodes.title: Griffin/Familiars
episodes.synopsis: Leaving the safety of the Golden Country, Senshi ends up in the clutches of a ferocious griffin. The crew must summon help if they want to save him.

episodes.title: Griffin Soup/Dumplings -1-
episodes.synopsis: Back at camp, Senshi finally reveals his painful history within the dungeon. The next day, the crew is rudely awakened by a perplexing transformation.

episodes.title: Dumplings -2-/Bacon and Eggs
episodes.synopsis: Still wrestling with their new forms, the crew must overcome the gargoyles. Later, they descend deeper into the dungeon. What monsters will they try next?

seasons.title: Temporada 1: Mentiras, Estrelato & Reencarnação
seasons.synopsis: Reencarnado como filho da lendária idol Ai Hoshino, Aqua adentra o lado sombrio da indústria do entretenimento em busca do responsável por uma tragédia.

episodes.title: Mother and Children
episodes.synopsis: Stories are lies meant to entertain, and idols lie to fans eager to believe. This is Ai’s story. It is a lie, but it is also true.

episodes.title: Third Option
episodes.synopsis: Ruby wants to be an idol for herself and for the little girl who died from cancer. The real world, however, doesn’t care about big dreams: something Aqua knows all too well.

episodes.title: Manga-Based TV Drama
episodes.synopsis: Aqua agrees to Kana’s request, but not for the reason she wants. There’s a connection between Masaya Kaburagi and Ai, which leads Aqua to the set of a TV drama for answers.

episodes.title: Actors
episodes.synopsis: Kana’s resolve remains strong despite her washed up reputation. Aqua sets the stage for her with a bold move that flips the script, which leads to opportunities for them both.

episodes.title: Reality Dating Show
episodes.synopsis: Despite different motivations, Aqua, Ruby and Kana’s key to success in the entertainment industry is the same; to achieve their goals, they need to play the game.

episodes.title: Egosurfing
episodes.synopsis: Remember what you said in righteous outrage online? There were consequences. You never saw them, but that didn’t make them any less real, nor hold you any less accountable.

episodes.title: Buzz
episodes.synopsis: Left reeling in the immediate aftermath, Akane’s costars unite in friendship and purpose: they will clear their friend’s name. They owe her nothing less.

episodes.title: First Time
episodes.synopsis: Focused on revenge, Aqua underestimated Akane and gave the talented actress a way to win his heart. If love is a game, Akane is playing for keeps and Kana is falling behind.

episodes.title: B Komachi
episodes.synopsis: MEM-cho won’t let her second chance go to waste and uses her influence to help grow B Komachi’s brand. Meanwhile, Aqua’s investigation into Ai’s past bears fruit.

episodes.title: Pressure
episodes.synopsis: B Komachi’s first performance approaches, but the group still needs practice while Kana refuses to be the center. Perhaps a certain expert choreographer could help them shine?

episodes.title: Idol
episodes.synopsis: MEM-cho has fans. Ruby has looks. But Kana has…? She’ll need to find the answer before she can be anyone’s star. Later, a fresh opportunity sets Aqua on a new path to revenge.

seasons.title: Temporada 2: O Palco 2.5D de Tokyo Blade
seasons.synopsis: Aqua, Kana Arima e Akane Kurokawa confrontam seus traumas emocionais no intenso espetáculo teatral de Tokyo Blade.

episodes.title: Tokyo Blade
episodes.synopsis: The stage is set. The actors are ready. And the curtain rises on the play, Tokyo Blade. However, there is another story aside from the play: that of the actors themselves.

episodes.title: Game of Telephone
episodes.synopsis:
The creator of Tokyo Blade isn’t happy with the unfaithful adaptation of her manga and demands a revision of the entire script. However, only twenty days remain until opening.

(Source; HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Rewriting
episodes.synopsis: Time is dwindling, and a question looms: a faithful Tokyo Blade adaptation or one tailored for theater? Amidst the tension, only one person can convince Abiko to compromise.

episodes.title: Emotional Acting
episodes.synopsis: Abiko and GOA collaborate on a new script and now the pressure is on the actors to bring the script to life. However, Aqua soon faces an unexpected challenge during rehearsal.

episodes.title: The Curtain Rises
episodes.synopsis: Aqua confides in Akane, revealing his true motives. She vows to remain by his side, but this deepening bond causes Akane’s rivalry with Kana to intensify.

episodes.title: Growth
episodes.synopsis: Melt regrets his poor acting in Sweet Today and vows to improve in Tokyo Blade. However, how can a subpar actor stand out among exceptional ones?

episodes.title: Sun
episodes.synopsis: Akane became an actress because she idolized Kana and wanted to be like her. However, one should never meet their heroes.

episodes.title: Trigger
episodes.synopsis: Their pasts shaped their acting. Kana wanted to shine as an actress, but she compromised to be useful. Meanwhile, Aqua’s childhood trauma led to a unique acting method.

episodes.title: Dream
episodes.synopsis: The actors shone brilliantly, and the curtain fell on a successful play, setting the stage for the next performance as Aqua and Taiki press the director for answers.

episodes.title: Liberation
episodes.synopsis: Taiki discovers a surprising connection, but reveals something Aqua wasn't expecting. Meanwhile, Ruby hopes one person in particular notices B Komachi's growing fame.

episodes.title: Freedom
episodes.synopsis: Aqua doesn't have to live for revenge and can finally look towards a brighter future. But what does this mean for the relationships he's cultivated in pursuit of a killer?

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.synopsis: The past never truly disappears. Aqua and Ruby return to the place they were born… and where, in another life, they also died.

episodes.title: Wish
episodes.synopsis: A gruesome discovery finally gives Aqua the closure he needs to begin a new chapter in his life. But as he steps into a brighter tomorrow, Ruby’s descent into darkness begins.

seasons.title: Temporada 3: Ascensão da B-Komachi & A Verdade Oculta
seasons.synopsis: Ruby abraça sua ambição implacável na mídia enquanto o plano de vingança de Aqua aproxima-se do verdadeiro mandante.
