seasons.title: Temporada 1: O Dilema de Dr. Tenma & A Ascensão de Johan
seasons.synopsis: O brilhante neurocirurgião Kenzo Tenma salva a vida do menino Johan Liebert em Düsseldorf, apenas para descobrir anos depois que salvou um monstro.

episodes.title: Herr Dr. Tenma
episodes.synopsis: Doctor Tenma is a brilliant Japanese neurosurgeon who works at Eisler Memorial Hospital in Germany. He is doing well professionally and is even engaged to the director's daughter, Eva. One day, a boy with a gunshot wound to the head is brought to him.

episodes.title: Downfall
episodes.synopsis: The price for disobeying Dr. Heinemann's orders to instead operate on the boy proves costly for Dr. Tenma and his career.

episodes.title: A Murder
episodes.synopsis: After three doctors are found dead, Tenma is reinstated as the chief surgeon. His career takes off, and even Eva tries to win him back. Unfortunately, all that success has attracted the attention of Detective Lunge.

episodes.title: Night of the Execution
episodes.synopsis: Adolf Junkers has information about the serial murders that is vital to the police, but he is afraid to reveal them. Dr. Tenma's care for Adolf Junkers however wins him over. However, his close relationship with Junkers leads him to a night of shocking horror.

episodes.title: The Girl of Heidelberg
episodes.synopsis: Nina Fortner, a talented young student in Heidelberg has been having nightmares. She also cannot remember anything about her life before she was 10 years old. She soon suffers from fainting spells at her university and starts receiving anonymous emails.

episodes.title: The Missing
episodes.synopsis: Nina finally receives an email informing her to meet the anonymous sender at a specified time and place. Meanwhile, Dr. Tenma asks Mauler, an editor for a local publisher, for assistance in his search for the Liebert girl.

episodes.title: House of Tragedy
episodes.synopsis: Tenma and Nina return to the Fortners’ residence to find Mauler and Nina’s parents dead. Two detectives arrive to take them to the station for questioning, but certain things don't look right.

episodes.title: Pursued
episodes.synopsis: Eva tries to threaten Dr. Tenma — unless he gets back together with her, she will reveal to the police that the tie that was found at the scene of the crime is his!

episodes.title: The Girl and the Seasoned Soldier
episodes.synopsis: An old mercenary soldier named Hugo is interrogated by Lunge about a student of his — a doctor named Tenma.

episodes.title: A Past Erased
episodes.synopsis: Tenma encounters a burglar named Heckel who claims to have seen the killer. It soon results in Heckel leading Tenma to a couple of murderers.

episodes.title: 511 Kinderheim
episodes.synopsis: Tenma learns that Johan used to be in an orphanage known as Kinderheim 511, where he meets an injured boy named Dieter and a former East German official named Hartmann who used to work there.

episodes.title: A Little Experiment
episodes.synopsis: Dieter is picked up by Hartmann before Tenma could return, and Tenma learns more about the experiments in Kinderheim 511.

episodes.title: Petra and Schumann
episodes.synopsis: In a small village, Dr. Schumann worries over the health of his sick but stubborn old friend, Petra.

episodes.title: Left Behind
episodes.synopsis:
Inspector Lunge investigates the murder of a prostitute and suspects a senator named Dr. Boltzmann of involvement. His dedication to his work however takes a toll on his family life.
Meanwhile, the vindictive Eva continues to press Lunge to catch Tenma. She also has a new lover, her gardener.

episodes.title: Be My Baby
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Tenma and Nina Fortner's investigations lead them to a powerful man known as 'The Baby', who belongs in an extremist organisation. They soon learn that the organisation has special plans for the Turkish district tomorrow.

episodes.title: Wolf's Confession
episodes.synopsis: Nina escapes the mansion. And Tenma meets with the unrecognizable General Wolf at the mansion later.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.synopsis: The extremists plans are put into action, and Tenma decides to postpone his search for Johan and instead heads to the Turkish district to warn the people there. Dieter and Heckel are captured by the skinheads and are left to burn in the fire. And Nina tries to get information about the 'main dish' from 'The Baby'.

episodes.title: Five Sugars
episodes.synopsis: Nina meets with an old friend and boss, Mister Rosso. The delightful old boss however, has a very dark past.

episodes.title: Monster's Abyss
episodes.synopsis: Tenma visits Rudy, a criminal psychologist, who is working on cases involving a murderer named Jurgens.

episodes.title: Journey to Freiham
episodes.synopsis: Tenma and Dieter hitch a ride with an elderly couple on the way to Freiham. Tenma wonders if the couple plan to turn him in.

episodes.title: Happy Holidays
episodes.synopsis: Nina confronts Muller, one of the two detectives responsible for the death of her foster parents, the Fortners. Muller discovers that his protege, Roberto, is actually working for Johan and is now tasked with killing Nina.

episodes.title: Lunge's Trap
episodes.synopsis: Lunge determines that the murder of a wealthy, middle-aged, childless couple does not fit the usual modus operandi of the serial murders and decides to use this opportunity to lure Tenma to a trap. However, before he can arrest him, Lunge is critically wounded by the real criminal. Tenma is able to treat Lunge's injuries.

episodes.title: Eva's Confession
episodes.synopsis: Eva Heinemann is arrested for public drunkenness and hooks up with Roberto, with whom she was with the night before her arrest. Roberto then reveals his link to Johan and Eva confesses that she was actually a witness the night Junkers was killed by Johan.

episodes.title: Of Men and Dining
episodes.synopsis: In exchange for her life, Roberto tells Eva to confront Tenma, who is currently treating a mob boss at a country house. Eva is promptly wounded by Roberto when she is unable to complete her task but is saved by Tenma.

seasons.title: Temporada 2: Os Segredos de Kinderheim 511 & Ruhenheim
seasons.synopsis: Tenma e Nina Fortner rastreiam as origens psicológicas de Johan através da Alemanha e Praga até o confronto filosófico final.

episodes.title: Thursday’s Boy
episodes.synopsis: Karl Neumann and Lotte Frank are both students who read latin to Hans Georg Schubert. Lotte attempts to assist Karl in finding out his past while trying to figure out the identity of a boy who reads to Schubert on Thursdays. When they both discover who he is, they find the boy, Edmund Farren, in his dormitory, dead.

episodes.title: The Secret Woods
episodes.synopsis: A man who claims to be the son of a millionaire has committed suicide, and a detective is determined to solve the case.

episodes.title: Proof
episodes.synopsis: Richard's past and present situation is revealed. Johan continues to bond with the Schuwald family and his intention is revealed.

episodes.title: Just One Case
episodes.synopsis: Richard re-investigates his old homicide cases and makes a frightening discovery.

episodes.title: Execution
episodes.synopsis: Robert delves into Johan's past and makes a shocking discovery. Dr. Gillen speaks to Peter Jurgens, a serial murderer about Johan's possible involvement and gets a tragic reply. Johan confronts Robert about Stephen Joos. And Dr. Reichwen receives tragic news from the police.

episodes.title: Decision
episodes.synopsis: Suspecting foul play in Robert's 'accidental' death fall, Dr. Reichwen makes some discoveries in his investigations. But as he later realizes, his investigations may have put him in harms way.

episodes.title: In Broad Daylight
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Tenma and Dr. Reichwen finally meet. Dr. Reichwen intends to proof Dr. Tenma's innocence in the homicides, but Dr. Tenma has other ideas.

episodes.title: Sanctuary
episodes.synopsis: Lotte, Frank and Karl are drifting apart. Lotte meets Nina Fortner and they become friends. Dr. Tenma searches for a perfect spot to shoot Johan.

episodes.title: A Child's View
episodes.synopsis: Dieter learns of a life threatening game that children are playing. Mr. Schuwald decides to donate his whole book collection to the Munich University Library under the suggestion of Karl and Johan.

episodes.title: At the Edge of Darkness
episodes.synopsis: The 'Margot Langer' impostor tries to blackmail Johan. Dr. Tenma helps a young 'doctor' at an illegal clinic

episodes.title: My Nameless Hero
episodes.synopsis: Lunge tries to get into Dr. Tenma's mind by pretending to be him. Dr. Gillen learns something about Johan during an interview with a psychotic killer. Dr. Reichwen tries to warn the Lieberts of Johan's true nature. Dr. Tenma scouts for a perfect sniping location.

episodes.title: The Monster of Chaos
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Reichwein reveals the true nature of Johan to Mr. Schuwald. Dr. Tenma gets ready to assassinate Johan. Lunge concludes that Dr. Tenma will kill Schuwald next. Lotte confronts Nina about Johan.

episodes.title: A Nameless Monster
episodes.synopsis: The episode begins with a fairy tale about a Monster without a name. Nina reads the story from the picture book and has a sense of deja vu. Johan's evil plans for the book donation ceremony is carried out. Dr. Tenma meets a big obstacle in his attempt to kill Johan.

episodes.title: The Demon in My Eyes
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Tenma has a gun pointed at Roberto, but Roberto has the rifle pointed at him. Nina, Dr.Reichwen and Dieter arrive to find the whole library in flames. People are trapped inside and the doors are all locked. Karl reads the report on his mother's life and death. Dr. Tenma tries to rescue those trapped in the building. Johan reveals the monster inside of him to Schuwald.

episodes.title: The Hell in His Eyes
episodes.synopsis: Lunge, from the BKA, learns that Johan may indeed exist. Nina goes into regressive hypnosis to learn more about the picture book and her past. Mr. Schuwald has a message for Dr. Tenma and sends Karl to Dresden to pass it to him.

episodes.title: Grimmer
episodes.synopsis: The episode introduces Grimmer. Grimmer is a freelance journalist doing an in-depth research into the abuses in the orphanages in East Germany. Grimmer meets with Dr. Tenma during their trip to Prague, and they become more acquainted when Tenma is faced with an immigration problem.

episodes.title: The Ghost of 511
episodes.synopsis: Grimmer stubbornly stalks Petrov for his experimental research papers chronicaling the abuses at Kinderheim 511, but he gets a surprise instead.

episodes.title: The Adventures of the Magnificent Steiner
episodes.synopsis: Grimmer has the key that Petrov gave him, and a former Czechoslovakian secret police organization wants it. Caught and tortured, Grimmer tells his abductors about 'the Magnificent Steiner'.

episodes.title: Detective Suk
episodes.synopsis: A new inspector, detective Suk is on the case of Zeman's homicide. During his investigation, he discovers that there is more to Zeman's murder than first assumed. Suk also meets a lady whom he falls head over hills for

episodes.title: Double Darkness
episodes.synopsis: After the death of his seniors, Suk is left to re-investigate case from the very beginning. He gets information from the orphans about a meeting with Grimmer. His intention to arrest Grimmer takes a different turn however when he gets deeper into the investigation. The episode also reveals that there is more to the nameless lady at the bar than she lets on.

episodes.title: The Monster's Afterimage
episodes.synopsis: Suk is put under surveillance by the new commissioner. Together with Grimmer, Suk retrieves the tape and research papers from the deposit box. But their movements is watched by various sides.

episodes.title: Contact
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Tenma learns about Suk's fugitive status from a journalist. And sets out to find him. Meanwhile, Suk and Grimmer goes into hiding, but is quickly found, surrounded and attacked by the STB. The STB's assault comes to a bloody end.

episodes.title: The Door to Nightmares
episodes.synopsis: Nina's experience in Prague is a nightmare for her. Tenma and Grimmer meets with a top man in the Czechoslovakian STB. They are offered a deal which Grimmer refuses to accept.

episodes.title: The Scariest Thing
episodes.synopsis: Johan visits Suk's mother. Tenma and Grimmer learns of his visit. They, including Col. Ranke, listen to Johan's tape. Lunge arrives in Prague for a 'holiday'. His investigation leads him to the sketches of Franz Bonaparta.

episodes.title: The Cruelest Thing
episodes.synopsis: Grimmer and Tenma tries to stop Johan from subjecting Milo, one of the orphans, to one of the most cruel fate.

seasons.title: Temporada 1: Lendas de Night City
seasons.synopsis: Em uma Night City dominada pela megacorporação Arasaka e implantes cibernéticos, David Martinez junta-se a Lucy e aos mercenários de Maine.

episodes.title: Let You Down
episodes.synopsis: After a night of streaming illegal braindance, David wakes up to reality: a rundown apartment with a broken washing machine and an overworked mother.

episodes.title: Like A Boy
episodes.synopsis: With his newly enhanced body, David heads to the Academy seeking revenge on his bully. Later, he meets a mysterious woman who wants to recruit him.

episodes.title: Smooth Criminal
episodes.synopsis: Surrounded by a group of rowdy edgerunners, David makes a plea to join their team. Meanwhile, sinister forces plot to lure him back to Arasaka Academy.

episodes.title: Lucky You
episodes.synopsis: Eager to learn the edgerunner ropes, David pesters Maine for another mission. Instead, Maine tasks Lucy with training him.

episodes.title: All Eyez On Me
episodes.synopsis: David makes a clever suggestion when the team strategizes for their next mission. However, he soon learns that their target can't be underestimated.

episodes.title: Girl on Fire
episodes.synopsis: Maine doesn't seem to be himself. But the team has bigger fish to fry: They must race against time to extract vital information from their prisoner.

episodes.title: Stronger
episodes.synopsis: Now an all-star edgerunner enhanced with more cybernetics, David leads his team into a new mission. An old contact reaches out to him for a big job.

episodes.title: Stay
episodes.synopsis: Faraday finds himself stuck between Arasaka and Militech. Lucy and Rebecca confront David about his change in behavior, but he refuses to listen.

episodes.title: Humanity
episodes.synopsis: Lucy's captors learn about her secret mission and dark past. David and his team head out to complete Faraday's job but realize that something is off.

episodes.title: My Moon My Man
episodes.synopsis: On the edge of cyberpsychosis but determined to save Lucy, David storms into Night City as Arasaka plots to deploy their ultimate lethal weapon.

steel-ball-run.title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

seasons.title: 1ª Parte: 1st Stage — Especial de Estreia (48 Minutos)

episodes.title: Episódio 1 (Especial 48 min) — 1st Stage: 15.000 Metros em San Diego Beach
episodes.synopsis: Especial de estreia de 48 minutos da 1ª Parte (1st Stage): Em 25 de setembro de 1890, Steven Steel dá a largada na praia de San Diego para os 3.852 cavaleiros. Johnny Joestar descobre o mistério da Rotação das Esferas de Aço de Gyro Zeppeli na corrida de 15.000 metros contra Diego Brando, Pocoloco e Sandman.

seasons.synopsis: Especial de estreia de 48 minutos da 1st Stage cobrindo os 15.000 metros iniciais da corrida Steel Ball Run em San Diego Beach.

seasons.title: 2ª Parte: 2nd Stage — Deserto do Arizona (8 Episódios)
seasons.ArcName: 2nd Stage: Travessia de 1.200 km no Deserto do Arizona

episodes.title: Episódio 1 — O Veredito da 1ª Etapa e a Largada no Deserto do Arizona
episodes.synopsis: Após a chegada explosiva da 1st Stage de 15.000 metros e a revisão de Gyro Zeppeli, os competidores encaram os 1.200 km mortais do Deserto do Arizona.

episodes.title: Episódio 2 — Atravessando a Floresta de Cactos e a Rota de Gyro Zeppeli
episodes.synopsis: Johnny Joestar e Gyro Zeppeli desviam da rota principal no Arizona enquanto assassinatos misteriosos no deserto colocam o xerife Mountain Tim no rastro dos corredores.

episodes.title: Episódio 3 — A Família Boom Boom e o Stand Magnético Tomb of the Boom (Parte 1)
episodes.synopsis: Benjamin, Andre e L.A. Boom Boom emboscam Johnny e Gyro no deserto usando o magnetismo letal do Stand compartilhado Tomb of the Boom.

episodes.title: Episódio 4 — Mountain Tim (Oh! Lonesome Me) e o Despertar do Tusk Act 1
episodes.synopsis: Com a chegada de Mountain Tim na Palma do Diabo (Devil's Palm), Johnny Joestar absorve o Braço Esquerdo do Cadáver Sagrado e desperta o Stand Tusk.

episodes.title: Episódio 5 — O Terrorista de Nápoles Oyecomova e Boku no Rhythm wo Kiitekure
episodes.synopsis: Oyecomova invade o acampamento de Gyro e Johnny buscando vingança contra a família Zeppeli com seus pinos-relógio explosivos.

episodes.title: Episódio 6 — A Rotação das Esferas de Aço e a Fuga pelo Desfiladeiro
episodes.synopsis: Sob a pressão das bombas de contato de Oyecomova, Johnny e Gyro combinam a Rotação da Esfera de Aço com as unhas giratórias do Tusk.

episodes.title: Episódio 7 — Os Anzóis Invisíveis de Pork Pie Hat Kid (Stand Wired)
episodes.synopsis: Enviado por Funny Valentine para capturar a parte do Cadáver Sagrado, Pork Pie Hat Kid ataca do céu usando os cabos dimensionais do Stand Wired.

episodes.title: Episódio 8 — Monument Valley: O Sprint Final da 2nd Stage contra Diego Brando
episodes.synopsis: Após derrotarem Pork Pie Hat Kid, Gyro Zeppeli, Johnny Joestar, Diego Brando e Sandman disputam a chegada eletrizante da 2ª Etapa em Monument Valley.

seasons.synopsis: Segunda etapa (2nd Stage) com 8 episódios acompanhando a travessia mortal de 1.200 km pelo Deserto do Arizona.
